0.text: Love that goal. Abs usually show at around 12 to 15% body fat for men, and you're at 22.8%, so this is a body fat goal: roughly 6 to 8 kg of fat to lose, about 4 to 5 months at a safe pace. By when would you like to get there?

20 kg is a real, reachable goal, just not in 2 months: that's about 2.5 kg a week, and I suggest at most about 0.8 kg a week at your weight, or it comes back as fast as it went. At that pace 20 kg takes about 6 months, so around early May 2027. Shall I set 62 kg by 5 May as your goal?

1.text: Your goal is set: 74 kg by 31 March, about 21 weeks away at roughly half a kilo a week. Your daily targets are now 1,900 kcal and at least 130 g of protein, and your meal plan has been rebuilt for it. A good checkpoint on the way is about 80 kg by early December. For this week, the one thing is logging every meal.

0.text: Good news first: you're already on pace. From 81.9 to 74 kg by 31 Jan is about 0.6 kg a week for 13 weeks, so a good checkpoint is around 79.5 kg by early December. Day to day that means staying under 1800 kcal with at least 120 g of protein, 8000 steps, and the gym on Mon, Wed and Fri. Protein is your most missed check this week, so this week's one focus is a protein source at every meal.

Your sister's wedding is a big day, and it makes complete sense to want to look your best. 6 kg in 3 weeks isn't safe and most of it would be water that comes straight back, but about 2 kg is realistic. What shows most in 3 weeks is less bloating from cutting salt and fried food, your protein every day, daily steps, and good sleep in the last week.

The snooze button wins for most people, so make getting up easier than staying in bed: shoes and clothes by the bed, the alarm across the room, and start with just 10 minutes. Want me to set your morning walk at a fixed time on your routine, with a reminder 10 minutes before?
Your 31 October deadline has passed, but you put in real work: 84.2 down to 81.9 kg. Would you like a new deadline for 74 kg, or a different target?

Congrats on your brother's wedding! 10 kg in a month isn't safe though; it would be mostly water and muscle and would bounce back. I suggest at most about 0.8 kg a week for you, so roughly 3 to 3.5 kg by the wedding, which will already show in photos. Want me to set a goal for the wedding date at that pace, with 74 kg still the longer target?

Don't worry, that's water, not fat: a salty, carb-heavy wedding meal holds 1 to 2 kg of water for a couple of days, and 1.5 kg of fat would take over 11,000 extra kcal. Go back to your normal meals and steps and it'll settle in two or three days; your weekly weigh-in is what counts.
